==Description==
The '''Roblox Deluxe Mystery Figure - Molten Boss''' is an official Roblox toy that was released in January of 2022. The toy offers the [[Molten Boss]]. Each part of the toy can be obtained in one of the six ''Roblox Deluxe Mystery Figure Packs - Series 2''. This toy does not have a redeemable code. The toy is recommended for ages 6+ and is not suitable for children under 3 years old.

==Prices & Stores==
Prices for each one of the six ''Roblox Deluxe Mystery Figure Packs - Series 2'' may vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. Generally, in total it costs around $135.65-$163.9 in the US and £53.94-£73.54 in the UK to get all the parts. The cost for each one of the ''Roblox Deluxe Mystery Figure Packs - Series 2'' is listed in their respective tab.
